mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of drywall installation for a new bump-out addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall costs are influenced by the total square footage of the added walls and ceiling, ceiling height, and the level of finish requested. Level 4 drywall finishing is typical for flat paint, whereas Level 5 provides a full skim coat to eliminate texture differences under high natural light. Other factors include whether structural ties create complex angles, the number of electrical cuts, and how much blending is required where the new bump-out connects to the older existing walls. We offer free quote consultations to review these site-specific conditions and provide upfront estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on square footage, ceiling height, finishing level (such as Level 4 versus Level 5 skim coats), and how much blending is needed to match the existing room.
